title: Plan compliance
tabs.label: Plan views
empty: No sessions were due in this period
period.label: Period
period.bad: Check the dates: the start must be before the end
kpi.rate_tip:
Of the sessions that were due, the share you did (done, partial and off plan all count as done).
Due = dated before today, or today and already done.
"Not synced" = a past day the synced data doesn't cover yet; left out for now.
Deleted past sessions don't count.
kpi.ok_tip:
The share done as planned (✓): time and TSS within ±20 % of the plan, and the right kind and intensity.
±20 % is TrainingPeaks' green compliance band; 20–50 % counts as partial.
"Off plan" = intervals planned but run easy (or the other way), or another sport.
kpi.tss_tip:
Due sessions: actual TSS ÷ planned TSS (intervals.icu's Compliance).
A missed session counts 0. The black mark on the bar is 100 %.
kpi.hours_tip: Due sessions: actual moving time vs planned time (strength excluded, like the weekly volume).
kpi.streak_tip:
Consecutive recent weeks with ≥ {pct}% of the due sessions done (threshold estimated).
The running week counts once it reaches the threshold; until then it doesn't break the streak.
phase.title: Current phase
phase.tip:
The current phase of the season plan: days gone, how much of the phase's sessions are done, how many are left.
Phase TSS = the planned TSS of all the phase's sessions (upcoming included); actual = what the due ones reached.
weeks.title: Planned vs actual per week
weeks.aria: Bars per week: planned (dashed outline) and actual (filled)
weeks.tip:
Dashed outline = the week's planned volume (the stored plan: done, missed and upcoming sessions); filled = what was actually done that week (every activity, unplanned ones included).
The same numbers as the weekly summary on the calendar.
trend.title: Weekly completion
trend.aria: Line chart of the weekly completion
trend.tip: The share of each week's due sessions that was done. Green = reached {pct}% (the streak threshold, estimated), orange = below.
kinds.title: By session type
kinds.tip: Each session type: green = done, orange = partial, hatched = off plan, red = missed. On the right: completion and count.
list.title: Sessions
list.tip:
The percentage is the compliance: actual TSS ÷ planned TSS, time when there is no TSS.
Click to open the session on the calendar (planned vs actual, re-pair).
